description: Source code for the TI HDC20XX humidity and temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, sampling, and configuration functions.

methods.name: ti_hdc20xx_int_callback
methods.description: Interrupt callback for GPIO, signals data ready via semaphore.

methods.name: ti_hdc20xx_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches temperature and humidity samples from the sensor.

methods.name: ti_hdc20xx_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sample data into sensor_value format for temperature or humidity.

methods.name: ti_hdc20xx_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the sensor device.

methods.name: ti_hdc20xx_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, verifies IDs, configures interrupts if available.
